findings.title: SUID Binary: find
findings.description: The find binary has SUID bit set, could be exploited to escalate privileges
findings.evidence: find / -perm -4000 -type f 2>/dev/null output shows find binary
findings.remediation: Remove SUID bit from find binary or restrict permissions

findings.title: Sudo NOPASSWD Rule
findings.description: Sudo configuration allows NOPASSWD for all users, critical security issue
findings.evidence: sudo -l output shows NOPASSWD: (ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL
findings.remediation: Remove NOPASSWD from sudoers file, require authentication

findings.title: Writable Cron Job
findings.description: Cron job with writable script path for privilege escalation
findings.remediation: Restrict cron script permissions, use root-owned scripts only

findings.title: AlwaysInstallElevated Registry Key
findings.description: Windows policy allowing MSI installation as SYSTEM user

findings.title: Exposed SSH Key
findings.description: SSH private key found in home directory with weak permissions
findings.remediation: Remove or rotate exposed key, set permissions to 600
